prompts.open:
Use case: product-mockup, true camera photographic realism.
Create ONE independent landscape 3840x2160 4K photograph, not a collage or contact sheet. Option 1, OPEN gift packaging. Supporting images 1 and 2 are the actual supplier carton structural references; image 3 exact print artwork; image 4 exact lam sticker; image 5 exact thank-you card.
Scene: pale warm limestone tabletop beside a window, natural morning light from the left, very subtle cinematic warm colour grade, Sony full-frame camera 50mm at f/5.6, crisp believable package textures, soft background depth and restrained shadows. No unrelated props.
Subject: ONE small square stock white exterior / kraft brown inside ONE-PIECE corrugated tuck-top folding mailer, proportions 20x20x10cm 2:2:1, matching actual supplier images 1-2. Lid attached and hinged to rear, opened upright at about 100 degrees. Its large rounded lateral locking tabs extend from the lid, and kraft corrugated interior visible. It is not a two-piece rigid box. Stock white exterior remains blank.
Inside: folded clothing fully hidden under very thin translucent ivory tissue like butter paper; delicate realistic crinkles, widely spaced tiny burgundy lam repeats copying the exact long upright stem and curved open bowl of image4. Tissue neatly folded closed and secured with one central round burgundy sticker with EXACT ivory lam from image4. Tissue should plausibly fit fully within the box.
Branding: one removable burgundy paper belly-band sleeve (not ribbon, no bow) lies naturally to the right of the open box, slid off then slightly flattened into its rectangular loop, broad enough to show its graphics. Use exact #5C1E32 and image3 artwork: exact ivory lam on top/bottom horizontal faces, full approved Arabic wordmark مُسدل on vertical front, small spaced M U S D A L beneath, exact lower-case domain musdal.com, restrained fine copper flowing wave pattern along lower edge. Copy the artwork precisely, do not improvise a different logo. Do not print on stock box.
An ivory thank-you card sits to the lower left beside box, reproduced from image5; small approved wordmark and only the exact heading "شكرًا لاختيارك مُسدل". No added copy, discounts, scratch, QR or extra slogan. The lettering must be correctly Arabic and naturally printed in burgundy.
Composition: realistic three-quarter view slightly elevated, entire open box including attached lid visible, tissue seal clear, sleeve and card clearly readable. One photograph filling frame with generous but not excessive breathing space, no text overlays, no watermark, no labels, no shopping bag. All assets must look physical, not rendered CGI.
